summary: This Standards Track document specifies the architecture, signaling, and procedures for Point-to-Multipoint Policies in Segment Routing, for both SR-MPLS and SRv6. It defines the policy construct, its candidate paths, and the instantiation of P2MP tree instances for efficient multipoint delivery. It updates RFC 9524.

eli5.summary: Instead of mailing the same letter many times, build one delivery tree that branches so each branch carries a copy toward its recipients.
